issue.title: 希望把桌面分身的小窗模式的还原单独加快捷按键

llm_context.input_title: 希望把桌面分身的小窗模式的还原单独加快捷按键
llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: The user is requesting a shortcut key or a dedicated button to restore the desktop clone window ('桌面分身的小窗模式') from its mini/small window mode back to its normal state, avoiding the need to go through a nested submenu every time.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: The current feature implementation for desktop clone small-window mode provides only nested context or sub-menu options for window restoration without binding a quick action key or direct UI button.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect Desktop Clone Window Controls
step_by_step_plan.description: Inspect the desktop clone window controls and sub-menu implementation to locate where small-window mode and restoration actions are handled.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add Direct Restoration Button or Shortcut Command
step_by_step_plan.description: Implement a direct UI button or bind a shortcut key to trigger the desktop clone window restoration from mini mode back to normal size.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add Regression Test
step_by_step_plan.description: Write a regression test ensuring that activating the restoration shortcut or clicking the direct button successfully transitions the desktop clone window from small-window mode to normal state.

step_by_step_plan.title: Run Test Suite
step_by_step_plan.description: Execute the build and test suite to verify that the desktop clone window restoration works correctly without regressions.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Managing different display states (minimized, small window, normal) of an application or clone window.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Provides users with flexible control over how they monitor and interact with background tasks or cloned game instances.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Directly relates to adding a quick toggle or shortcut mechanism to transition the desktop clone between small window mode and normal mode.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Mapping global or local key combinations to trigger specific application actions.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Enables users to perform frequent operations quickly without navigating through menus using a mouse.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Fulfills the user request for a dedicated shortcut key to restore the window state.

common_pitfalls: Modifying unrelated window management logic or breaking existing desktop clone sub-menu functionality.
Forgetting to handle global shortcut registrations properly if the shortcut needs to work while the window is unfocused.
